ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg, pale yellow to golden with darker yellow streaks, soft fluffy curds with a slightly glossy sheen, spread across the upper right of the plate in an irregular mound about 10 cm by 8 cm, roughly 1.5 cm thick, sitting beside the mushroom-like pieces | 120
ITEM 2 | Whole round cooked pieces, grey-brown to tan, smooth matte skin with slight wrinkling, about 2.5 cm diameter each, five or six pieces clustered in the lower center of the plate, one with a darker cap-like top, firm and holding shape | 110
ITEM 3 | Sausage-like cylinder pieces, brown to tan with darker browned ends, smooth surface, about 2.5 cm long and 2 cm wide, one piece cut crosswise showing a pale interior, sitting at the lower center next to the round pieces | 45
ITEM 4 | Orange-red carrot pieces, glossy and slightly moist surface with some caramelized edges, cut into chunky batons about 3 cm long by 1.5 cm wide, two or three pieces at the bottom of the cluster | 50
ITEM 5 | Dark brown to black small round piece with a wrinkled, slightly glossy surface, about 2.5 cm across, sitting at the right edge of the food cluster next to the egg | 20
